clips.send: Someone doubting themselves sends this to a friend who was told as a kid they weren't smart enough, as quiet vindication.
clips.caption:
Somewhere, a kid got told they were too dumb to do something. Most people carry that sentence into adulthood and never question it.

Kevin Trudeau's answer is a line from Henry Ford, one of the richest men who ever lived: if you believe you can, or if you believe you cannot, either way you are right.

It is not motivational-speaker fluff. Steve Jobs said it. Elon Musk says it. Warren Buffett's own partner, Charlie Munger, believed it until the day he died.

The thinking is what makes it true, in either direction.

Whose voice is still running in your head, and is it even yours?

#kevintrudeau #selfbelief #mindsetmatters #henryford #successhabits #overcomedoubt
